name: 86 Chaos 17.0.8
label: 86 Chaos 17.0.8
notes: Removes temporary Vercel build-workspace hashing from the deployment-critical path and binds deployment identity to Vercel Git commit/branch metadata plus the committed deterministic source manifest.
Keeps strict workspace verification as an opt-in diagnostic instead of a default that can block legitimate Vercel builds.

Makes build-identity stamping fail open for deployment but fail closed for certification: degraded identity evidence no longer kills the app build, while the release gate still refuses certification without a valid manifest hash.
Preserves the 17.0.5 schedule role reconciliation, release-gate execution repairs, and mobile microphone placement unchanged.
title: 86 Chaos 17.0.8
summary: Deployment-safe identity architecture that separates Vercel build availability from release certification evidence.
description: Preserves application behavior while removing fragile Vercel workspace assumptions from prebuild identity stamping and retaining strict commit/manifest checks in the certification gate.
